$comment: Shrink-only allowlist enforced by scripts/ci/wrangler-usage-guard.test.js. Lower counts as usage is removed; a new entry, count growth or changed gap needs a fresh structured admitted object with a repository PR decision URL and reason. Uses conservatively count every Wrangler token, including comments. See apps/docs/build/development-tools/cf-cli-wrangler-parity.mdx.

do-publication-rehearsal.reason: Existing Durable Object Workers must retain applied v1 production migration tags until disposable same-history migration/data-retention rehearsal proves cf exports publication parity.
do-publication-rehearsal.owner: cf/Void Wrangler-exit lane; release orchestrator owns rehearsal acceptance and the separate publisher promotion.
do-publication-rehearsal.removal: Remove only in a separately reviewed cf publisher change carrying the disposable migration and data-survival rehearsal receipt.

opennext-adapter.reason: Parley and Lettin publish through @opennextjs/cloudflare, which reads wrangler.jsonc and invokes Wrangler; cf has no OpenNext adapter.
opennext-adapter.owner: Parley/Lettin TanStack Start on Void migration lane (orchestrator assigns)
opennext-adapter.removal: Delete when the app runs on Start + Void and publishes its exact artifact with cf deploy --prebuilt.

parity-tooling.reason: Migration tooling reads former wrangler.jsonc files and their normalized baselines to prove cf deployment-identity parity; it runs no Wrangler CLI and ships no Wrangler config.
parity-tooling.removal: Delete with the tooling once every native Worker is on cf and its production cutover is verified.

paused-runtime.reason: Retained paused runtimes (apps/backend, apps/tanstack-web) and their paused CI/tests; AGENTS.md forbids updating them during active work.
paused-runtime.removal: Migrate to cf + Void when the runtime resumes, or delete with the runtime when it is retired.

pending-migration.reason: Native Worker with no cf capability gap for its operations, awaiting its per-service parity PR (Durable Object migrations need manual exports conversion and a disposable rehearsal).
pending-migration.removal: Delete in the service PR that moves it to cloudflare.config.ts, cf types, Build Output parity and cf deploy --prebuilt.

producer-inventory.reason: Compiler qualification detects pre-existing wrangler types producers and cf types equivalents; its detector and data-only regression fixture perform no invocation.
producer-inventory.owner: Development tooling and native type-check qualification owner
producer-inventory.removal: Remove the compatibility detector and fixture admission after every declaration producer uses cf types and no legacy producer needs recognition.

security-path-classification.reason: security path classification of wrangler config filenames, not CLI invocation
security-path-classification.owner: Security review cadence and CI tooling maintainers
security-path-classification.removal: Remove when security path classification no longer references legacy configuration filenames, or the guard has a reviewed config-filename reference rule.

shared-toolchain.reason: Root wrangler devDependency supplies the CLI for every remaining gap; trustedDependencies, .wrangler ignores and policy tests cover @cloudflare/vite-plugin 1.x, which depends on the wrangler library.
shared-toolchain.removal: Delete when no other allowlist entry needs the Wrangler CLI and @cloudflare/vite-plugin 2.x (no wrangler dependency) is adopted.

void-wave1-publication.reason: Void deploy always rebuilds and provisions (--skip-build is static-only in Void 1.1.12 and 1.2.1), so Wave 1 Start + Void apps publish the exact Void-emitted config with Wrangler.
void-wave1-publication.removal: Delete when Void builds emit a cf Build Output (or Void ships a prebuilt Worker deploy) and cf deploy --prebuilt publication is proven byte-identical.
